notes: Augmentation Evoker: support spec that buffs allies via Ebon Might and Breath of Eons. Personal damage is secondary to buff uptime.

Ebon Might.description: Core CD. Buffs 4 allies with % of your stats. MUST be kept at 100% uptime. Extends with Eruption casts.

Breath of Eons.description: Primary DPS+support CD. Accumulates 10% of ally damage during duration then detonates.

Prescience.description: Gives ally 3% haste for 18s. Prioritize highest DPS players.

Eruption.description: Personal damage + extends Ebon Might by 1s per cast. Core spam during Ebon Might.

Upheaval.description: Empowered AoE CD. Use on cooldown.

Blistering Scales.description: Places absorb on tank. Cast on cooldown.

Fire Breath.description: Empowered AoE DoT. Applies Ebon Conduit vulnerability.

Living Flame.description: Secondary filler when Ebon Might is down.

Ebon Might.description: Buffs 4 allies with 15% of your primary stat. Keep at 100% uptime.

Shifting Sands.description: Augmentation personal haste buff. Active during Ebon Might.

major_cooldowns.use_condition: Keep at 100% uptime. Extend with Eruption casts.
